From: Aditi Sharma <aditi@medhealth.io>

Cc: security@medhealth.io
Date: Fri, 04 May 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedHealth: IAM attestation & SCIM/SAML evidence — next steps

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the walkthrough earlier today. We (MedHealth security) are starting our SIG/SOC2 intake and need a short evidence bundle to close the IAM section. Can you confirm you can provide the following artifacts by EOD next Thursday (May 11)?

- SAML assertion samples (at least 3, showing NameID and attributes)
- SCIM delta export (last 30 days) and a sample full snapshot
- RBAC/role ownership matrix mapped to application IDs
- Session authentication logs for a 7-day window (redacted PII ok)
- Proof of least-privilege efforts (examples of service account pruning / RBAC changes)

Attached is our short questionnaire to help map fields (MedHealth_SIG_questions_2028-05.pdf). If any of these are sensitive, we can accept redacted samples and a signed evidence transfer agreement.

Also please share a point of contact and a small mutual action plan so our audit team knows what to expect.

Best,
Aditi
Aditi Sharma
Security Lead, MedHealth Inc
(attachment: MedHealth_SIG_questions_2028-05.pdf (application/pdf))

Hi Aditi — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire (received). We're able to provide the requested artifacts; plan below.

Mutual action plan (high level):
1) Today (May 4): confirm scope and owners (this email).
2) May 5–8: collect artifacts (SCIM snapshot, SAML examples, RBAC matrix).
3) May 9: internal review and redaction where necessary.
4) May 10: upload secure bundle to shared Drive and send transfer link + access token.
5) May 11: MedHealth confirms receipt and we schedule a short call for questions.

Owners at Redwood: Markus will lead the SCIM exports and session logs; Grace will assemble the RBAC matrix and least-privilege notes. I will coordinate delivery and run the internal redaction pass.

Two quick asks:
- Do you need logs in a particular timezone / window (UTC preferred)?
- Please confirm whether a redwood-internal MSA is sufficient for the transfer or if you need a DTA prior to upload.

I'll start collecting artifacts and will attach a sample SCIM export for your review by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance Operations | Redwood Inference

Estimated delivery: May 9 (internal review May 10). I'll upload artifacts to the shared Drive folder and post the secure transfer link.

Attachments I'm preparing: scim_delta_snapshot_20280504.csv, saml_assertion_examples.txt, auth_session_20280502-08.log (redacted).

-Markus
